label: QTTR (Mar 2026)
provenance: Averaged cumulative probabilities [optimistic, pessimistic] computed from the raw expert response counts in the report's Appendix A.4 ('Quantum factoring responses and analysis'), using the report's own optimistic/pessimistic cumulative assignments: EU 1/0, VU 5/1, U 30/5, N 70/30, L 95/70, VL 99/95, EL 100/99 (percent). rawBins supplied and verified against in-report stated values during prototyping (Handoff Addendum #1, A-2); recomputing the weighted averages from rawBins with the assignments above reproduces every anchor to within ±0.05. Cross-checked against in-report stated values (~15% optimistic at 5 years; 28-49% at 10 years; 51-70% at 15 years). Anchor keys are years elapsed from the publication date. Labeled 'QTTR (Mar 2026)' to match the accompanying article's usage ('the March 2026 Quantum Threat Timeline Report'). Anchor values are the prototype v0.4 values of record and must not be recomputed or corrected in place.
